sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. Applicability, ship and load-case ownership, exclusive analysis/calculation alternatives, ratio 0.8, weakest-direction evidence, status comparison direction, units, operands, and expected-result-scaled formula tolerances are correctly encoded; freeze for later RDF evaluation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the alternative structure: formula operands and the calculated load/reference-strength checks must be required only in the calculation branch, while the approvedNonlinearBladeStressAnalysis branch must be able to satisfy the OR without all calculation inputs and results being globally mandatory.
